feeds.title: Global Issues
feeds.description: Global Issues sheds light on global issues that are sometimes misunderstood but are all interconnected. List of topics covered includes social, political, economic and environmental issues, including human rights, economy, trade, globalization, poverty, environment and health-related issues.

feeds.title: Pecunia et Bellum
feeds.description: Keep up with articles and news on International Relations, Political Economy and Grand Strategy.

feeds.title: E-International Relations Blog
feeds.description: E-International Relations is the world's leading open access website for students and scholars of international politics. We publish a range of original content including books, articles, blogs, student essays, book reviews and interviews with leading scholars.

feeds.title: The New York Times
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with News on International Relations, including commentary and articles published in The New York Times.

feeds.title: LSE International Relations Blog
feeds.description: LSE International Relations is a forum for those interested in increasing the impact of social sciences on government policy, society, and business.

feeds.title: Australian Institute of International Affairs
feeds.description: The Australian Institute of International Affairs (AIIA) is an independent, non-profit organisation seeking to promote interest in and understanding of international affairs in Australia.

feeds.title: OpenCanada.org
feeds.description: OpenCanada.org is a publication of the Canadian International Council, the Centre for International Governance Innovation and the Bill Graham Centre. They produce multimedia content to explain, analyze and tell stories about the increasingly complex and rapidly shifting world of foreign policy and international affairs.

feeds.title: Young Australians in International Affairs
feeds.description: Young Australians in International Affairs aims to connect, engage and empower the next generation of Australian leaders in international affairs.

feeds.title: Spheres of Influence
feeds.description: The exclusionary nature of International Relations creates a major barrier to gaining a comprehensive understanding of the problems we face and silences the voices we should be listening to the most. Spheres of Influence is a non-profit dedicated to making sense of the world of International Relations. The team, made up of students from a diverse spectrum of backgrounds, are passionate about making complex topics accessible to everyone while offering a refreshing alternative to the mainstream media.

feeds.title: International Affairs Blog
feeds.description: The official blog of International Affairs, the peer-reviewed journal of Chatham House. Explore and get expert analysis and interviews from the journal contributors on current political issues.

feeds.title: Foreign Affairs
feeds.description: Since its founding in 1922, Foreign Affairs has been the leading magazine for in-depth analysis and debate of foreign policy, geopolitics, and international affairs. Foreign Affairs is published by the Council on Foreign Relations (CFR), a non-profit and nonpartisan membership organization dedicated to improving the understanding of U.S. foreign policy and international affairs through the free exchange of ideas.

feeds.title: University Of Kent » Politics and International Relations News
feeds.description: Welcome to the university of ambition Where desire meets determination. We stand for ambition, with our diverse community of staff and students committed to making a difference at the regional, national, and global levels. It's something we're very proud of. Browse through Politics and International Relations News and discover the up to date school and research news on various topics related to current and world affairs.

feeds.title: The Journal of Diplomacy and International Relations
feeds.description: The Journal of Diplomacy and International Relations blog (hosted on Seton Hall University's platform) serves as the annual academic journal's online home, offering a public forum where emerging scholars and practitioners in international affairs share analysis, opinion pieces, and feature articles on current global issues.

feeds.title: World Politics Review » Iraq
feeds.description: World Politics Review provides an uncompromising analysis of critical global trends to give policymakers, analysts, academics, and readers with a deep interest in international affairs. Written by a network of leading experts and on-the-ground influencers, our substantive content gives you access to comprehensive and detailed perspectives.

feeds.title: RAND » International Affairs
feeds.description: The RAND Corporation is a nonprofit institution that helps improve policy and decision making through research and analysis. It focuses on the issues that matter most such as health, education, national security, international affairs, law and business, the environment, and more

feeds.title: AsianPolyGlotView
feeds.description: Asian Polyglot View Blog offers unique news and views on a variety of topics including macroeconomy, finance, international relations, current events, public policy and foreign languages for US, China, Japan and Korea.

feeds.title: TalkDiplomacy Articles
feeds.description: TalkDiplomacy writes articles about topics and events related to history, politics, and international relations with the intention of broadening people's understanding of our world and help connect the past to the present to create a better future.

feeds.title: Yale University Press London Blog » International Affairs
feeds.description: Yale University Press London Blog is the official blog of Yale university press, London. We publish history, politics, current affairs, art, architecture, biography, and pretty much everything else. In the International Affairs blog you will get all the ;latest news and updates about international affairs that is updateded regularly.

feeds.title: Brookings » International Affairs
feeds.description: The Brookings Institution is a nonprofit public policy organization based in Washington, DC. which brings together more than 300 leading experts in government and academia from all over the world who provide the highest quality research, policy recommendations, and analysis on a full range of public policy issues.
